title: Category app foundation skeleton: Navigation, breakpoints, and Tabs
user_prompt: Build a category app for news or commerce. Use Navigation as the root container and manage the page stack. Use WidthBreakpoint and HeightBreakpoint for multi-device adaptation: a bottom single-column TabBar on phones, side navigation with two or three columns on tablets, breakpoint-based List lane and GridRow column counts, and compact, aggregated, or multi-row search layouts by device form. Output a complete development plan.
intent: Verify that the category app foundation skeleton consistently routes to ARKUI-11, covering the Navigation, breakpoint, and Tabs page skeleton scenario.

title: Map navigation composite page: Stack, floating panels, and drawer
user_prompt: Build a map navigation page using Stack as the root container. The full-screen map supports one-finger panning and two-finger zooming, with a frosted floating navigation bar at the top, zoom/layer/location controls at the bottom right, and a bottom drawer with a drag handle and three snap heights. Each overlay uses independent state and respects the safe area. Output a complete development plan.
intent: Verify that the map navigation composite page consistently routes to ARKUI-11, covering the Stack, floating panel, and drawer scenario.
